assets.title: T2.1 | LOCK: timeout & hierarchy
assets.content:
1 "TIMEOUT: wait limit, not expiry"
LOCK +^Data(1):5
IF '$TEST { WRITE "Busy",! QUIT }
// Acquired: protected work may exceed 5 s
LOCK -^Data(1)
Timeline Request -> wait <=5 s -> acquired -> work -> release.
"Success: $TEST=1. Expiry: $TEST=0; protected work must be skipped."
Yellow: "Timed LOCK does not automatically throw <TIMEOUT>. Check $TEST immediately."
Keyword chips "ACQUIRE" "WAIT" "NO TTL"

2 "NO timeout vs :0 vs :5"
Code/result rows:
LOCK +^Data(1)     // Wait indefinitely; $TEST unchanged
LOCK +^Data(1):0   // Normally one immediate attempt
LOCK +^Data(1):5   // Wait up to 5 seconds
"For :0 and :5, $TEST reports success (1) or failure (0)."
"Without a timeout, a conflicting request waits until acquisition unless interrupted."
Yellow footnote ":0 exception: requesting a parent while owning a child uses an internal 1-second timeout."
Keyword chips "BLOCKING" "TRY NOW" "$TEST"

3 "HIERARCHY: same branch, different requests"
Owner A: LOCK +^Data("account",1001)
Tree root ^Data -> account -> siblings 1001 [locked] and 1002; under1001 child balance.
"Other process B tries each independently:"
LOCK +^Data("account",1001,"balance"):0  // $TEST=0
LOCK +^Data("account"):0               // $TEST=0
LOCK +^Data("account",1002):0           // $TEST=1*
"*Assume no other conflicts, same database mapping. Release B's successful lock."
"Unlock the acquired parent name; unlocking a child does not release it."
Keyword chips "ANCESTOR" "DESCENDANT" "SIBLING"

assets.title: T2.1 | LOCK: cooperation & release
assets.content:
4 "COOPERATIVE: LOCK does not guard SET"
A holds LOCK +^Data(1).
Two laptop processes with raw read/write arrows bypassing padlock and a lock-request arrow waiting.
"B, WITHOUT requesting a lock:"
WRITE $GET(^Data(1)),!  // Proceeds; dirty read possible
SET ^Data(1)=999        // Proceeds; may break A's update
"B, using the SAME locking protocol:"
LOCK +^Data(1):0        // $TEST=0 while A owns it
IF '$TEST { QUIT }      // Do not read/modify protected data
"Shared locks coexist; exclusive locks conflict. Shared does not make SET illegal."
Keyword chips "COOPERATE" "DIRTY READ" "LOST UPDATE"

5 "COUNT + deferred release"
"Independent snippet; start at $TLEVEL=0:"
LOCK +^Data(1)       // Count 1
LOCK +^Data(1)       // Count 2
LOCK -^Data(1)       // Count 1: still held
LOCK -^Data(1)       // Count 0: released
"Inside a transaction:"
TSTART
LOCK +^Data(1)
LOCK -^Data(1)       // Final unlock deferred (Delock)
TCOMMIT             // Outermost end completes release
"Alternative: LOCK -^Data(1)#\"I\" can release immediately at final count."
Keyword chips "COUNT" "DELOCK" "IMMEDIATE"

6 "COMMIT/ROLLBACK are not explicit UNLOCK"
"Independent snippet; start at $TLEVEL=0:"
TSTART
LOCK +^Data(1)
SET ^Data(1)=10
TROLLBACK           // Data undone; explicit lock still held
LOCK -^Data(1)       // Balance acquisition AFTER rollback
"TCOMMIT alone also leaves a still-counted explicit lock."
"On second-lock failure, unwind the first (outside a transaction):"
LOCK +^Data(1):5
IF '$TEST { QUIT }
LOCK +^Data(2):5
IF '$TEST { LOCK -^Data(1) QUIT }
// Success path must eventually release both
"Argumentless LOCK targets this process's entire lock set; inside a transaction release timing still applies."

assets.title: T2.1 | SQL: isolation & table locks
assets.content:
1 "ISOLATION: inspect this process"
WRITE $SYSTEM.SQL.Util.GetOption("IsolationMode"),!
"Returned value:"
"0 = READ UNCOMMITTED (default): dirty reads possible."
"1 = READ COMMITTED: normal read waits for pending updates."
"3 = READ VERIFIED: rechecks query conditions; dirty reads possible."
"Choose READ COMMITTED using embedded SQL:"
&sql(SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED)
IF SQLCODE<0 { WRITE SQLCODE," ",%msg,! QUIT }
WRITE $SYSTEM.SQL.Util.GetOption("IsolationMode"),!  // 1
"Setting belongs to the process; verify in each session. Query-feature exceptions apply."
Keyword chips "PER PROCESS" "VISIBILITY"

2 "%NOLOCK: bypass read isolation"
"Session A, starting with no active transaction:"
&sql(START TRANSACTION)
&sql(UPDATE Account SET Balance=999 WHERE AccountId=1)
// Keep transaction open; assume UPDATE succeeded
"Session B, same namespace:"
&sql(SELECT %NOLOCK Balance INTO :bal
     FROM Account WHERE AccountId=1)
"May return 999 before A commits, even if B uses READ COMMITTED."
"Later A runs ROLLBACK: 999 was never committed."
"Compare: SELECT without %NOLOCK at READ COMMITTED normally waits for A's update."
Yellow "Read-only does not mean consistent. Put %NOLOCK directly after SELECT."
Keyword chips "DIRTY READ" "ROLLED-BACK DATA"

3 "TABLE LOCK: acquisition must be balanced"
"SQL-managed escalation: transaction end releases its locks."
"Explicit table lock: matching UNLOCK is required."
"Embedded SQL success-path skeleton, no outer transaction:"
&sql(START TRANSACTION)
&sql(LOCK TABLE Account IN EXCLUSIVE MODE WAIT 5)
IF SQLCODE<0 { &sql(ROLLBACK) QUIT }
// Protected SQL work; check every result
&sql(UNLOCK TABLE Account IN EXCLUSIVE MODE)
&sql(COMMIT)
"UNLOCK requested before COMMIT; normal release is deferred. On work failure: balance lock, then roll back."
"Default uncommitted SELECT may still read a locked table."
"Inspect escalation threshold:"
WRITE $SYSTEM.SQL.Util.GetOption("LockThreshold"),!
Keyword chips "AUTOMATIC vs EXPLICIT" "MATCHED RELEASE"

assets.title: T2.1 | Errors, deadlocks & 2PL
assets.content:
4 "ERRORS: result channel matters"
Table Situation / Outcome:
"Timed ObjectScript LOCK expires" / "$TEST=0; no automatic <TIMEOUT>"
"SQL LOCK wait / normal DML lock timeout" / "SQLCODE=-110"
"READ COMMITTED waiting read expires" / "SQLCODE=-114"
"TCOMMIT at $TLEVEL=0" / "<COMMAND> *NoTransaction"
"256th nested TSTART" / "<TRANSACTION LEVEL>"
"Capture embedded SQL diagnostics BEFORE cleanup:"
IF SQLCODE<0 {
 SET errCode=SQLCODE,errMsg=%msg
 &sql(ROLLBACK)
 WRITE errCode," ",errMsg,!
}
"Snippet assumes this operation owns the transaction. CATCH alone does not clean up."
Keyword chips "$TEST" "SQLCODE / %msg" "EXACT ERROR NAME"

5 "DEADLOCK: same order, every time"
Cycle diagram: A owns1001 waits1002; B owns1002 waits1001.
"Prevention: both transfer directions acquire increasing IDs."
SET first=$SELECT(from<to:from,1:to)
SET second=$SELECT(from<to:to,1:from)
LOCK +^Data(first):5
IF '$TEST { QUIT }
LOCK +^Data(second):5
IF '$TEST { LOCK -^Data(first) QUIT }
// Transactional work + cleanup on all paths
"Fragment assumes no outer transaction or existing locks. Release both on success/errors."
"Timeout bounds waiting; unwind before retry. Timeout alone does not prove deadlock."
Small chips "PESSIMISTIC = lock first" "OPTIMISTIC = validate version"

6 "2PL: when may I acquire again?"
Timeline "GROW: acquire only" -> "SHRINK: release only"
"VALID, outside transaction for immediate release:"
LOCK +^Data(1)
LOCK +^Data(2)
LOCK -^Data(1)    // Shrinking begins
LOCK -^Data(2)
"INVALID 2PL sequence:"
LOCK +^Data(1)
LOCK -^Data(1)
LOCK +^Data(2)    // New acquisition after release
"Strict 2PL holds exclusive locks until commit/rollback."
"2PL can still deadlock. It is not 2PC (distributed commit)."
"TSTART + arbitrary LOCK calls does not enforce 2PL."
